subject: general
question: If 20 March 2001 is Tuesday, then what will be the day of the week on 23 April 2021?
solution:
An ordinary year has 1 odd day and a leap year has 2 odd days. 

So, the day on the same date for an ordinary year will be 1 day ahead and the day on the same date for a leap year will be 2 days ahead for the next year.

If 20 March 2001 is Tuesday, then the day on these dates will be:

20 March 2002 → Wednesday

20 March 2003 → Thursday

20 March 2004 → Saturday
